Definition: probably from G3306; remaining, i.e. sole or single; by implication, mere:--alone, only, by themselves.
BiblicalUsage: Monos means alone, only, single — this is life eternal, to know the only true God, and man shall not live by bread alone, and to the only wise God our Saviour be glory and majesty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word draws a circle round God alone: only He is God, only His word feeds, only His glory lasts.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
